title: Finder Workspace Extensions
summary: A macOS companion that brings project status, tasks, work sessions and Quick Look previews into Finder.

caseStudy.problem: Folders make projects easy to find, but task progress and next steps are hard to see while browsing.
caseStudy.role: I built the native companion, Finder extension, project viewer and Quick Look provider.
architecture: Finder Sync shows status badges and opens focused windows for tasks and work sessions.
Better Workspace publishes linked project metadata. The companion sends edits back as requests and checks that the underlying record still matches before applying them.
validation: Real Finder captures show status badges and Quick Look against a sample collection.
limitations: Development preview. Release distribution and additional native Finder entry points still need acceptance.
